params.body:
## The bidding card invites, and the toolbar matches the other lists

The card of #893 said the deadline in words, but it said it in near-black semibold with a clock, at 16px, right above the button. It was the darkest thing on the card and read as a warning; with the seller and three lines of facts in grey above it, nothing on the card asked for a bid. The toolbar above the cards was two bare native selects.

### The card

- **A quiet footer.** The deadline and the button share a footer on a tinted ground (`--brand-field`) at the bottom of the card. Left: "Nog 6 dagen" in the brand blue at weight 500, with "tot en met 07/10/2026" small under it. Right: the button, the one strong element. The clock icon is gone.
- **Amber only on the last day**, as before: "Laatste dag" with "tot middernacht" under it. That second line was "bieden kan tot middernacht", which wrapped over two lines beside the button; it is shortened in nl, fr, en, de and es (`ui.bidding_until_midnight`).
- **Title at 18px**, more air (20px padding, 12px between the parts). Seller, facts with their icons and the expected delivery date are unchanged in content.
- **Buttons in a row end on the same line**, with and without the delivery line and with a model name over three lines: the footer is pushed to the bottom of the card.
- **The button has no gavel icon any more**: at three cards per row the label does not fit beside the date with it. It stays at least 44px high. When the two do not fit beside each other (four or five per row) the button drops under the deadline and takes the full width; on a phone the footer always stacks, deadline above a full-width button.
- **Recently ended cards** follow: same title and facts, and a footer with "2 biedingen" and "afgelopen op 21/09/2026" under it, no button.

### The toolbar

- **Sort** is the `ui-menu` the other lists use (`ui-sort-item` rows, the bottom sheet on a phone). The button names the current order ("Sorteren op: Nieuw toegevoegd eerst"), the chosen row carries a check and `aria-current`. A row sets `orderBy` through Livewire, so `updatedOrderBy` still validates the value and remembers it per user.
- **Cards per row** is a segmented choice of radio buttons, two to five, bound with `wire:model.live="perRow"` as the select was (arrow keys move it; the cookie is unchanged). Hidden below 1200px, as before.

Styles are Tailwind in the blade. `refresh.css` loses the three `.ui-card-actions` rules, which only the old button row of this card used (5 lines, budget lowered in `tests/quality-ratchet.json`); `.ui-sort` and `.ui-per-row` stay in use by the stocklist list.

The shared pieces of #896 (`x-ui.badge`, `x-ui.facts`) are not used here: the card has no state badge of its own, and `x-ui.facts` is a label and value list, not the icon line this card keeps.

### Business rules

R B1-2.9 now says where the deadline stands and how it looks, the shorter last-day line, the stacked footer on a phone, the sort menu and the cards per row. R B1-2.13 says the bid count and end date stand in the footer of the recently ended card.

### Tests

- `TheBiddingCardReadsAtAGlanceTest`: the last-day detail is "tot middernacht"; on the rendered card the deadline and the button stand in the same footer, the deadline is `font-medium` in `text-brand-blue-deep` and never ink or semibold, the button is 44px, and amber stands on "Laatste dag" itself. The existing checks stay (words not a bare number, the year once, no middot, no spaced capitals).
- `TheBiddingOfferToolbarTest` (new, `@rule B1-2.9`): the menu lists every option of `orderByOptions()` in order and marks only the current one; choosing another moves the mark and the button label, an unknown value falls back to the default; the cards per row are radios for 2 to 5 bound to `perRow`, a choice sets the grid and an out-of-range value falls back to 3.

Checked in the browser on the demo dataset at 1440 (three per row) and 390: no horizontal scroll, buttons aligned per row, the long model name wraps, the sort menu opens as a sheet on the phone and sorting from it reorders the cards.
params.title: The bidding card invites: a quiet footer with the deadline beside the button, and the toolbar of the other lists
